description:
Cancels a workflow run that is in flight, returning { runId, cancelled: true }. Fails with an error when the run has already finished or does not exist.

**Toolset:** Workflows

**Parameters:**
- runId (number) *required*: BearQ workflow run ID to cancel.

runId.description: BearQ workflow run ID to cancel.

name: bearq_stop_workflow_run
title: BearQ: Stop Workflow Run
